desc:
Welcome to Hide & Block, a hide and seek game where you can break everything...

HIDE - Find clever hiding spots, explore the environment and use your surroundings to stay out of sight

SEEK - Grab your sword, track down the hiders and eliminate them before time runs out!

DESTROY - Break blocks, create new paths, escape dangerous situations and reshape your hiding spot. Everything is destructable!

EXPLORE - Play across different maps, each filled with unique environments and creative hiding opportunities

CUSTOMIZE – Unlock new tool skins, kill effects and cosmetics to stand out!

Will you be the last hider standing, or will you find everyone before time runs out?

Good luck and thanks for playing

[VR ]SUPPORTED!
